name: What specific features of a luxury home are best highlighted by a 3D tour?

mainEntity.name: What specific features of a luxury home are best highlighted by a 3D tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 3D tour excels at highlighting the unique and luxurious features of a high-end home that static photos cannot fully convey. This includes intricate architectural details, custom-built elements, high-end material finishes like marble or exotic wood, and the flow between grand living spaces. It can also effectively showcase amenities such as home theaters, gourmet kitchens, spa bathrooms, and stunning outdoor entertainment areas, all of which are common in luxury properties across locations like Boca Raton or Key Biscayne.
acceptedAnswer.description: 3D tours best highlight intricate architectural details, high-end finishes, custom amenities, and the spatial flow of luxury homes, enhancing the viewing experience.
